title: berteroa incana
intro: Berteroa incana, commonly known as Hoarystem or Hoary Alison, is a perennial plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae). The health benefits of Berteroa incana include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may help in reducing inflammation and protecting cells from damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, as well as its potential to exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Berteroa incana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
